corridor_notes: Short local gas-supply branch (供气支线) tapping the Phase 2 Tongliang-Qianjiang trunk at 12#阀室 in 大湾镇 (Yubei District) and running into Yubei District proper to serve local gas demand. The Phase 2 EIA explicitly lists this as one of the 8 Phase 3 supply branches: '8条供气支线管道包括重庆境内...渝北供气管道...分别分布于重庆市大足区、潼南区、璧山区、合川区、渝北区、长寿区、垫江县，湖北省巴东县，总长135.6km' (combined length of all 8 branches). GEM's ResearcherNotes label this '二阶段' (Phase 2); per the EIA's own phase breakdown these 8 named branches are Phase 3 (三阶段) scope -- see note under P7568.
researcher_notes: 12#阀室's identity/location is well-corroborated (exact table match + two nearby groundwater wells). The downstream end point is district-level only -- the branch-specific EIA (which would give exact terminus, e.g. a gas-supply station or distribution point in Yubei) is still in public-comment stage per the country notes and was not locatable via WebFetch/archive.org search (WebSearch budget for this session was exhausted before reaching this PID; relied on archive.org + Nominatim only).
